observations.decision: Donnée de q équivaut : \unsure{l|la} donnée de
observations.evidence: Donnée ends without an additional s; équivaut has the t ending. Two separated points make a colon. The following tall loop gives l, but no separately secure a follows; retain R2's l|la doubt.

observations.place: first Aut argument and upper traces
observations.decision: retain G|Z; retain two drawn traces with writing/surface uncertainty
observations.evidence: Reinforced roof and rounded lower counter leave G/Z open. Above left of Aut, a distinct upper dark point and a paler elongated lower mark are detached; no punctuation role assigned.

observations.decision: deleted unsure q|g beneath live sigma
observations.evidence: A long descender with a small lower loop survives beneath the reinforced sigma, allowing q and g; overwriting is definite.

observations.decision: l'ens; retain deleted unsure des
observations.evidence: The live low e/n/s run supports ens rather than un. A horizontal cancellation crosses the following old word; d ascender remains but middle/end obscured.

observations.decision: unsure pl.|pol.; retain à un nb
observations.evidence: After a descending p, the next isolated upper loop favors contracted pl.; no distinct o is secure, so pol. remains alternative. Separate à, un and nb are present after it.

observations.decision: resolve cotés with no circumflex; applic textsuper n
observations.evidence: Only the acute above e is visible; the o has no roof. The application word ends in a shortened low c and a separate raised n-like ending.

observations.decision: resolve autom without point
observations.evidence: Low initial au, tall t and flattened om ending are present; the broad gap before non contains no point.

observations.decision: resolve bijection
observations.evidence: After t the ink gives dotted i and a low on-shaped final run, not a ve ending; separate terminal point.

observations.decision: retain state uncertainty: unsure{deleted elle|live elle}; new unsure ce
observations.evidence: The two tall/looped forms and short ending establish elle. Its heavy connecting line overlaps the usual cursive joins, so cancellation remains probable but not secure. The following separate short low word favors ce but its inner e is not fully separated.

observations.decision: resolve bijectif
observations.evidence: The final tall descending hooked f is distinct and is followed by a separate comma, with no ve sequence.

observations.decision: retain deleted unsure mais
observations.evidence: A long cancellation traverses the middle; an i-like dot and s ending survive, but the opening is overtraced too heavily to remove uncertainty.

observations.decision: retain deleted unsure pour tt before ses fibres
observations.evidence: Initial p descender and terminal pair of crossed t strokes are visible, while the middle of pour is obscured. It is on the ses fibres line above Sommet, not a separate cancellation before the heading.

observations.decision: gén. resolved; élémt|élément retained; Mon resolved; symétrie|symetrie and sss|ssi new doubts; conjugués retained
observations.evidence: g descender, raised accent and short n with point support gén. The element noun contracts its ending. Mon has capital M, rounded o and low n without t/point. The accent in symétrie is not separately secure. Three crowded shorthand strokes have no distinct final i dot. conjugués intersects the curved boundary.

observations.decision: opposés d'ordre n=2m, alors u^m=bar u^m=s; unique underlined; élémt d'ordre underlined through ordre; called symétrie; sont and mod; slanted lines, separate heavy upper rule and long thin curve
observations.evidence: Opposés has two prominent p descenders; 2m and raised m powers are visible, as is the bar. Underline beneath order phrase stops before 2. Separate strokes of different weight extend beside the slanted text and the Parenthèse region.

observations.decision: retain S|B; E/S top, P/F bottom; q' and q upward; p'/q' broken; p/q solid
observations.evidence: Upper-right object has an open top curve but reinforced left stem/lower bowl. Both vertical arrowheads are at the upper row. The lower horizontal and left vertical shafts consist of separate dashes.

observations.decision: resolve C17 as geometric drawing without lexical assignment
observations.evidence: A definite bulbous vertical dark stroke ends in a leftward hook. This is securely reproducible as a shape; its purpose and letter status are left unassigned.

observations.decision: draw two diagonal points in unsure marker
observations.evidence: Lower round and upper slightly elongated dark dots are real visible traces, but separated far from the set expression; writing versus surface trace remains undecided.

observations.decision: first grpes|groupes; hom without stop; hom de grpe|groupe; P un grpe|groupe; ds|dans; final grpes|groupes
observations.evidence: Each noun independently has a long g descender with a compact middle that does not separate ou; the shorter forms are favored. No point follows hom. Before cat., d and a reduced low continuation favor ds, but the intermediate letters are too reduced to exclude dans.

observations.decision: raised :E—S with curve; both map strokes headless; both bijectif) have no opening parenthesis
observations.evidence: The colon/E—S sits above the start of surjectif over a shallow rising curve. Both map shafts have blunt ends. In each bijectif the tall left stroke joins the b body; no independent left parenthesis is visible. Separate right parentheses remain, with a final point.

observations.decision: retain deleted unsure diagrammes; inserted carrés above it
observations.evidence: The cancellation covers most letters of diagrammes, leaving d and g traces. The smaller live carrés is centered above, with its acute, not on the following baseline.

observations.decision: resolve ex.; retain reordered grpe|groupe|grpes|groupes
observations.evidence: An open e, crossed x and detached point appear without a t. The final noun has a long g descender and a compact low run lacking independently secure ou or terminal s.

observations.decision: left-align q-value and conjugation-chain starts; place boxed repeat beneath right-hand part
observations.evidence: The q_t and sigma_tg start near the same left edge, while their equals signs have different x positions. The box starts beneath the later part of the chain.

observations.decision: tt retained
observations.evidence: Two tall adjacent t strokes are visible, including the right crossbar; the form is not the low un written elsewhere.

observations.decision: vides ou de cardinal 2...
observations.evidence: Distinct vides and a separate short ou occur between sont and de; H's toutes removes that contrast.

observations.decision: separate underline Sommet and opposé; Produit fibré d'ens singular
observations.evidence: Two independent rules lie below the two heading words. Produit and fibré have no plural s; the final word is a low ens sequence.

observations.decision: inclusion begins level with lower square row; vertical = below initial P; no extra P or comma
observations.evidence: The P of the inclusion is near the lower P/F row. Two short nearly vertical strokes lie below it, followed by the set expression. There is no second P and no comma after E×F.

observations.decision: capital P, Pb
observations.evidence: The first sign has the tall bowl of capital P; lower-case b follows.

observations.evidence: Each relation has exactly one undulating stroke, without a lower bar.
